rules.question: How does a report view turn a value the row may lack into a sort key?

owner_lines.why: the one conversion every report view's optional columns call

rules.note: The path view's ms_key and the DM view's own optional_key were two copies of this conversion; both now call the shared one. A column with its own reason to give an empty key (the DM view's posted date, a percent shown only beside an optimal score) writes the condition and calls optional_key or SortKey{} for the empty case, which this row does not flag.
